description: Name-based agent-to-agent token payments on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.32.1): registry names with PDA vaults, transfers by name, daily caps, allowances, invoices and crankable subscriptions. register_agent, deposit, transfer_by_name, set_daily_limit, approve, transfer_from, create_invoice, pay_invoice, create_subscription, execute_subscription and withdraw were verified with lab tokens.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of Sterdam/solclaw. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/solclaw. The lab changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program and set USDC_MINT to the Sol.College devnet lab mint. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (name registry, payments, allowances, invoices, subscriptions)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/solclaw/
QA: devnet proof of agent-to-agent payments
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Exercise batch_payment and split_payment on devnet
